exposure: presence of risk factors for GDM
Presence or absence of GDM risk factors
outcome: Maternal metabolic parameters (during pregnancy and up to 1 year postpartum)
finding: Women with no GDM risk factors still experienced a high prevalence of adverse perinatal and postpartum outcomes, while the presence of risk factors, particularly pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity and high-risk ethnicity, further increased the risk for adverse postpartum metabolic outcomes.
mod_finding: The study does not report specific findings related to mode of delivery.
